Input: `data` (1-2000 characters, at most 2953 UTF-8 bytes), optional `format` (svg | png, default svg), `scale` (pixels per module 1-20, default 8), `error` (L | M | Q | H, default M) and `border` (0-10 modules, default 4). Returns `svg` (text) or `data_base64` (PNG)" → after: "utilpeek: make a QR code image. Input: `data`, optional `format`, `scale`, `error` and `border`. Returns `svg` (text) or `data_base64` (PNG), or with `output` "url" a 24 h download link, plus `version`, `modules`, `width_px`, `height_px` and `bytes`. Data too long for a QR code at the chosen level i"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
